objective: Require local release-index pin metadata for optional OpenTofu S3/GCS object-source module download locations without claiming live object-store precondition execution.

best_practice_sources.what_it_establishes: OpenTofu module sources include archive URL and object-store source patterns such as S3 and GCS archive sources.
The module-registry download endpoint returns a location value consumed by OpenTofu as the module source.
S3 versioning assigns distinct version IDs to object versions; this ChangeSet records version-id metadata but does not execute S3 calls.
S3 object integrity is tied to checksum validation; this ChangeSet only binds release-index source integrity metadata to the local archive SHA-256.
Cloud Storage objects carry generation metadata and checksums; this ChangeSet records generation metadata locally only.
Cloud Storage supports generation preconditions for safe object operations; no live precondition call is claimed.
Supply-chain integrity evidence only helps when verified; signing/SLSA/VSA verification remains a non-claim here.

implemented_claims: Cloud IaC app release-index parser accepts archive_source_integrity_sha256, archive_source_version_id, and archive_source_generation optional fields.
Object-source rows require archive_source_integrity_sha256 to exactly match archive_sha256 as lowercase SHA-256 metadata.
S3 object-source rows require archive_source_version_id and reject archive_source_generation.
GCS object-source rows require non-zero decimal archive_source_generation and reject archive_source_version_id.
Pin metadata values fail closed for missing, secret-like, whitespace/control, malformed, mismatched, wrong-provider, and orphan-without-source cases.
explicit_non_claims: No bucket provisioning or IAM policy enforcement.
No S3 version-id or GCS generation precondition execution.
No signed URL or CDN integration.
No production authentication, Cedar policy evaluation, tenant identity, TLS termination, persistence, or database adapter.
No signing, SLSA, VSA, provider runtime, tofu plan/apply, deployed endpoint, Argo CD/Kubernetes rollout, cloud provisioning, production readiness, or FD-001 tenant workload hosting.
false_green_findings_closed: Object-source release-index rows can no longer be accepted with only an object location and no local integrity/provider pin metadata.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed green.
Aggregate ./bin/oya gate run-all is not claimed green unless freshly rerun and proven.
Live object-store adapters, signed module verification, and production auth/Cedar remain future slices.
Repo-local release-index entries still use local archive routes; no production object-store release index has been materialized.

findings: Kept the slice narrow: metadata pin validation only, no fake live S3/GCS adapter.
Strengthens object-backed module distribution toward immutable object/version addressing without overclaiming runtime cloud behavior.
Negative tests cover missing pins, mismatched integrity, wrong-provider metadata, secret-like version ID, malformed generation, and orphan pin fields.
Existing local release-index rows without archive_source_location remain compatible.
Focused app tests, full app tests, scoped matrix, fmt/check/clippy, governance, and Cloud IaC gates passed.

F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: Local pin metadata is the smallest honest hardening step before live object-store adapters and credentials exist.
rejected_reasons: Live adapters require credentials, buckets, IAM, and precondition evidence outside this slice.
Location-only rows are too weak for hyperscaler-grade object distribution.

findings: Pin metadata rejects credential-like tokens and binds source integrity back to release-index SHA-256 metadata.
Parser-only validation adds no live object-store I/O path.
Version/generation metadata is now explicit, but compliance-grade retention/precondition evidence remains non-claimed.
Local /artifacts/modules release-index entries are unchanged because pin metadata is only required with archive_source_location.
Malformed object-source pin metadata fails at release-index load time before serving a download response.
ChangeSet is tied to Oya VCS claim, source/tests, manifest/catalog/tasks, multispectrum evidence, and audit-chain rows.
Used Oya VCS claim; avoided raw git/gh; read root hub and operating contract; kept /plan complementary-only; did not claim production/hyperscaler completion.
No new dependencies were introduced. Strict dependency-seam gate is run as closeout evidence.

review_findings: No critical/high issues found for the local foundation scope. Live object-store adapter/precondition verification remains an explicit gap.
